_comment: Persisted baseline routing distribution for PSI drift monitoring. Written by STEP 15 (FAIRNESS) on first run with current batch values; reused on all subsequent runs. Schema: routing category -> empirical probability (0-1, sums to 1.0 over the 5 categories). The 5-level routing is produced by FraudGuard and is the same one used in M7/M8.1.
_source: First persisted run of M8.1 (commit 8d96398). Update by deleting this file and re-running the pipeline.
